When on, DynamicNotch records which app is in front and for how long, and how often this Mac is unlocked. The data stays on this Mac, is never sent anywhere, and daily totals older than 90 days are deleted.
Time without keyboard, mouse or trackpad input is not counted. Time while this Mac is asleep or locked is never counted.
Excluded apps are not recorded, and what was recorded for them before is hidden.
This deletes every recorded day on this Mac. It cannot be undone.
